scope: installation verify is read-only and reports home, receipt validity, database/WAL presence, current and expected schema, upgrade_required, ready
installation seal writes one durable receipt only when the database schema equals the code head; same-head replay is idempotent, different head is rejected
Receipt validation is a pure domain rule rejecting non-UTC timestamps, unexpected fields and malformed schema/head
open_instance verifies an existing receipt: schema mismatch raises installation_mismatch, corrupt or linked receipts raise installation_invalid, absence stays compatible
installation artifact verifies a local wheel read-only: SHA256, zip CRC, member count/uncompressed caps, path traversal/backslash/absolute names, duplicates, V2 assets and METADATA

installation stage copies a verified wheel atomically to home/updates/<sha16>/artifact.whl with staged.json (extracted=false, installed=false); same-SHA replay is idempotent and corrupt receipts fail closed

installation prepare unpacks a staged, hash-unchanged wheel into updates/<sha16>/tree after re-validating CRC/bounds/paths/duplicates and V2 assets; prepared.json makes replay idempotent and partial trees are cleaned

installation switch-plan is read-only: requires prepared candidate, sealed receipt matching the database schema and an unused instance, then lists backup/stop/switch/migrate/seal/start/health with executable=false

installation backup executes only the plan's backup step: reuses switch-plan preconditions, creates a consistent snapshot outside home, refuses to overwrite, records manifest SHA256 and is idempotent per wheel SHA
installation rollback-check restores the recorded backup into a new sibling directory, verifies integrity/schema, records rollback.json and is idempotent; the live home is never modified

limits: No real wheel install, service switch, migration or rollback was executed.
